body.en: Depreciation as an adjustment: debit it to profit and loss and deduct it from the asset in the balance sheet. Bad debts are amounts that cannot be recovered at all. Further bad debts given as an adjustment are added to the bad debts in the trial balance (debited to profit and loss) and deducted from debtors in the balance sheet.

points.en: Depreciation: P&L Dr; deduct from asset
Further bad debts: add to bad debts; deduct from debtors

title.en: On the board: From debtors to good debtors

say.en: Start with debtors of 1,00,000 and write off further bad debts of 2,000.
New provision for doubtful debts: 5 percent of 98,000 is 4,900.
Provision for discount: 2 percent of what is left, 93,100, is 1,862. Debtors are shown at 91,238.
Charge to profit and loss: old bad debts plus further bad debts plus new provision minus old provision.

title.en: Provision for doubtful debts and for discount

body.en: A provision for doubtful debts is created at a percentage of debtors after deducting further bad debts. The amount charged to profit and loss is bad debts plus the new provision minus the old provision. A provision for discount on debtors is calculated on debtors after deducting further bad debts and the new provision for doubtful debts.

points.en: Order: bad debts → doubtful debts → discount

narration.en: A provision for doubtful debts is created at a percentage of debtors after deducting further bad debts. The amount charged to profit and loss is bad debts plus the new provision minus the old provision. A provision for discount on debtors is calculated on debtors after deducting further bad debts and the new provision for doubtful debts.

title.en: Bad debts and provision for doubtful debts

caption.en: New provision = rate × (debtors − further bad debts). Charge to P&L = bad debts (TB + further) + new provision − old provision.

problem.en: Debtors ₹1,00,000; bad debts in the trial balance ₹3,000; further bad debts ₹2,000; old provision for doubtful debts ₹4,000; new provision 5%; provision for discount on debtors 2%. Find the charge to profit and loss and the debtors in the balance sheet.

steps.en: Debtors after further bad debts = 1,00,000 − 2,000 = ₹98,000; new provision = 5% × 98,000 = ₹4,900.
Charge for bad and doubtful debts = 3,000 + 2,000 + 4,900 − 4,000 = ₹5,900.
Provision for discount = 2% × (98,000 − 4,900) = 2% × 93,100 = ₹1,862, debited to P&L.

answer.en: P&L: ₹5,900 for bad and doubtful debts and ₹1,862 for discount; debtors shown at ₹91,238.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಅವಕಾಶ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ವಸೂಲಾಗದ ಸಾಲ ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ. ವಿಧಿ = ವಸೂಲಾಗದ ಸಾಲ + ಹೊಸ ಅವಕಾಶ − ಹಳೆಯ ಅವಕಾಶ. ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಕಳೆದ ನಂತರದ ಸಾಲಗಾರರ ಮೇಲೆ. ಸವಕಳಿ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಕಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
